The '''TR-14a Land Carrier''' was one of the most expensive and elegant [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] ever made. They were modeled after ancient wheeled carriages, and were incredibly expensive. They could come with gilded scrollwork, family crests and heraldry, or custom interior upholstery. They were also very heavy [[Armor/Legends|armored]] to protect the dignitary riding inside.

The basic layout was a large central passenger compartment with large [[Turbothruster/Legends|turbothrust]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] in front. A [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] would ride in an open-air [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] in the back. Lift producing repulsors were contained in small outriggers.
